payload.entry: Real-Obsidian acceptance run (athena, bob-cli 5b4c2636 clean debug bob sha256 452229ac…, same fixtures/harness) found 2 regressions in landed ccfc12b, now fixed in bob-plugins (committed by this turn): (1) album/bank released ownership scope-wide, so a pane's stale Reading binding for an earlier note unhid the current card's rows (album record-prop-hidden-on-album failed; record properties-hidden-after-plugin-reenable failed) and record's clear could wipe another card's newer owner -> per-adapter path-tagged mount slots (propertyCardSlotOwn/Release/ReleaseAll) releasing only the adapter's own generation-bound handle; record keeps only its handle (dead copy painter removed). (2) album/bank Live Preview scope is .markdown-source-view, which the shared API denies, so LP never hid record/bank (bank hub-bank-property-hidden failed) -> own on view.dom (.cm-editor) and one bounded ungated CSS rule for tagged rows; record CSS unchanged. Final vs baseline 36d4801: album 120/121 = base (new record-prop-hidden-on-album-live check added; fails on ccfc12b), bank 75/78 = base, record full 144/144 x2 = base, 0 console exceptions; screenshots album 36/36 + bank 20/20 byte-identical, record 22/25 identical with 3 proven timing-noise diffs. npm test 7397 pass 0 fail, validate 11/11, ownership unit tests 13/13. Evidence: file:explicit:5366ba3f1c91e381b416eb0b (summary), file:explicit:d19bd1571d8869c3fbd0f94c (baseline bundle), file:explicit:6ef537cd9927c600b96c5526 (final bundle). -r Record ownership phase acceptance evidence and fixes

payload.entry: Host phase verified. The earlier uncommitted host work was evicted by a launch-time re-clone of the linked bob-plugins checkout, then restored from the SASE rescue patch (base e2cdc8d) onto bob-plugins ccc0f72. Fixed a new regression: the record adapter file-open/layout-change ran a full host refresh, which made bank walk-real-key-swallowed fail 3/3. onWorkspaceEvent now replaces the default refresh, and unit tests pin both cases. Final tree: album 120/121 and bank 75/78, both the same failure sets as ownership; record full 144/144 twice (one earlier run hit a markdown-neutral flake). bob-cli 5b4c2636, bob sha256 979bdf89. Bank screenshots 20/20 byte-identical; album 35/36 (the 1 diff is a transient toast); record diffs are known noise. npm run validate 12/12; focused suites 317/317; npm test 7500 pass / 2 unrelated failures. Evidence: file:explicit:b9fee3d94935c22cdac23dbb (summary), file:explicit:e0c4d18220635127d479ffc0 (bundle). Deployed via bob plugins sync (ccc0f72 + uncommitted host diff).

Fixed the record file-open full-refresh regression that broke bank walk-real-key-swallowed (3/3 fail before, 2/2 pass after; clean base passes). Final e2e on the same bob binary (5b4c2636, sha256 979bdf89): album 120/121 and bank 75/78 match ownership exactly; record full 144/144 x2 (one flaky markdown-neutral run). Bank screenshots 20/20 byte-identical. validate 12/12; focused suites 317/317; npm test 7500 pass, 2 unrelated failures (base copy-card row order; perf load flake). Evidence: file:explicit:b9fee3d94935c22cdac23dbb, file:explicit:e0c4d18220635127d479ffc0. Deployed with bob plugins sync. No epic symbols.
